'''December 2001 Hoth scenario tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG scenario (non-sanctioned) in December 2001. [[Michael Hawley]] won it. It is known from Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3205">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-21-father-william-on-hoth-revisedd3205/ father-william-on-hoth-revised], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 21 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-21-father-william-on-hoth-revisedd3205/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' December 2001
* '''Players:''' 4
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Hawley]]
